research_question: At the same frozen index and exact 128-bit document payload, does a query-conditioned score metric plus deterministic non-uniform bit allocation produce a stable Recall@10 advantage over the V13 unsupervised uniform RPQ16x8 baseline?
scope: post-V13 architecture diagnostic on the already opened V13 development role; not fresh development, independent confirmation, an official MS MARCO score, a ScaNN implementation, or a production latency claim

parent_evidence.diagnosis: fixed-assignment signed-score regression reduced its surrogate but changed only nine primary-seed queries; V14 changes representation capacity rather than adding another supervised centroid loss

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: whether the single preregistered anisotropic 128-bit representation warrants a new fresh-query development protocol
forbidden_claims: generalization beyond the frozen restricted corpus

input_contract.reuse_reason: architecture screening only; any GO requires a new disjoint query freeze

method.basis: deterministic uncentred PCA rank-64 fit only on residual rows reached by the four training folds
method.query_metric: cutoff-weighted projected-query second moment, ridge regularized and trace normalized independently in each four-dimensional block
method.rate_proxy: weighted mean squared norm of candidate residual coefficients after the query-metric Cholesky transform
method.rate_allocator: exact deterministic dynamic programming minimizing sum_m A_m * 2^(-2*b_m/4) subject to integer b_m in [6,10] and sum_m b_m=128
method.quantizer: independent Faiss k-means in each transformed block with 2^b_m centroids; decoded centroids are mapped back to PCA coefficient space
method.packing: little-endian contiguous bitstream with exactly 128 bits per document

comparators.primary: committed V13 unsupervised PCA64 RPQ16x8 per-seed OOF arrays
comparators.uniform_whitened_ablation: same query metric and transformed block k-means with exactly 8 bits in every block
comparators.base: committed V13 Base M32 IVF-PQ arrays

prohibited_actions: using relevance labels to fit PCA, query metrics, rate allocation, or codebooks
using held-out folds to fit any representation component
changing the bit range, rate proxy, metric, seeds, or thresholds after outcomes appear
selecting the best seed or fold
opening oracle_audit, future_method_holdout, or any old RARS holdout
claiming the reused V13 role is fresh evidence
claiming production efficiency from the Python evaluator
